root_cause.P0-2_palette_executorType_lost: web/src/canvas/bpmn-palette-provider.js's createAction() called elementFactory.createShape(Object.assign({ type }, { 'choros:executorType': 'agent' })). bpmn-js's ElementFactory.createElement (node_modules/bpmn-js/lib/features/modeling/ElementFactory.js) only lifts a FIXED allow-list of keys onto the created businessObject: processRef, isInterrupting, associationDirection, isForCompensation, isExpanded (via applyAttribute helpers), isHorizontal, triggeredByEvent, cancelActivity, and eventDefinitionType/eventDefinitionAttrs (special-cased). Any other key — including a raw 'choros:executorType' — rides untouched through the final `assign({id...}, size, attrs, {businessObject, di})` in diagram-js's base ElementFactory.create(), landing as a stray property on the returned SHAPE object itself, never on businessObject or businessObject.$attrs. So the Agent Task palette entry created an indistinguishable bare bpmn:ServiceTask — exactly the live-proof symptom (exported XML had no choros:executorType at all).
root_cause.P0-3_panel_never_expands:
web/src/canvas/bpmn-properties-panel.jsx's PanelGroup rendered `{open && (
…
)}` — the entries div was only MOUNTED when open===true, but it never received the literal `.open` CSS class. editor.css keys visibility off exactly that class: `.bio-properties-panel-group-entries { display: none }` + `.bio-properties-panel-group-entries.open { display: flex }`. Conditionally mounting a node is not the same as toggling the class the stylesheet requires — the div was in the DOM (when open) but still matched only the base `display:none` rule, since no element in the app ever carried the `.open` class. Every section (executor-type selector, agent picker, role assignment, form binding, timer/message config) was permanently invisible regardless of the arrow icon's rotation state (a cosmetic, unrelated toggle) or React's `open` boolean. gateway-condition-panel.jsx's GatewayConditionPanel (an always-expanded section with no PanelGroup wrapper of its own) had the identical bug independently — same class, same missing `.open`.

fix_summary.P0-2: createAction(type, group, cssClass, title, shapeAttrs, executorType) now takes shapeAttrs (forwarded verbatim into createShape — ONLY for bpmn-js allow-listed keys like eventDefinitionType) separately from executorType (a plain 'agent'|'service' string). After the shape is created, if executorType is set, it is dual-written onto shape.businessObject via writeConfigAttr(bo, 'executorType', 'choros:executorType', executorType) — the SAME helper already used for agentRef/autonomyLevel/formContractRef/messageName/etc. in element-config-contract.js. This writes BOTH the registered moddle property (bo.executorType, the saveXML round-trip path) and the $attrs fallback (bo.$attrs['choros:executorType'], the legacy/import-compat path) — exactly mirroring every other choros:* attribute in the codebase. 'create.choros-agent-task' now passes executorType='agent'; 'create.choros-service-task' passes 'service'; 'create.choros-user-task' and the lane/timer/message-catch entries pass no executorType (unchanged behavior, verified by regression tests).
fix_summary.P0-3: PanelGroup's entries container is now ALWAYS rendered (not conditionally mounted), with its className toggled between 'bio-properties-panel-group-entries' and 'bio-properties-panel-group-entries open' based on the `open` state — the exact class editor.css's selector requires. Because AgentTaskPanel/TimerDeadlinePanel/MessageCorrelationPanel/OutcomesPanel/UserTaskFormBindingPanel all receive PanelGroup as a prop from the parent (bpmn-properties-panel.jsx), this single fix unlocks raising for every typed sub-panel without touching their own code. gateway-condition-panel.jsx's two always-expanded '.bio-properties-panel-group-entries' divs got the '.open' class added directly (it renders its own section chrome, not via the shared PanelGroup).

cross_check_against_backend_contract: src/core/agent-task-external-mapper.ts exports AGENT_EXECUTOR_TYPE = "agent" and reads the raw-XML-tokenized LOCAL attribute name 'executorType' (namespace prefix stripped by the tokenizer) — comparing it against that constant. The palette fix writes choros:executorType="agent" via bpmn-moddle serialization, which is namespace-consistent with what the mapper's tokenizer expects. No backend file was read-write touched; this was a read-only cross-check to confirm the frontend fix produces XML the existing backend mapper/agent-dispatch chain already understands. Confirmed via a headless bpmn-js ElementFactory + BpmnModdle(choros extension) + moddle.toXML() test that the LITERAL string 'choros:executorType="agent"' appears in the exported XML on the serviceTask element.
test_methodology_note: This repo's web vitest tier deliberately runs in a DOM-free 'node' environment (see web/vitest.config.js) and its existing tests (e.g. bpmn-ensure-layout.test.js) explicitly avoid instantiating the full BpmnModeler (needs a DOM container). Following that precedent: (1) the palette test instantiates bpmn-js's REAL ElementFactory + BpmnFactory classes directly against a real BpmnModdle instance (both are plain, DOM-free constructor functions) plus one line replicating BaseModeler's `moddle.ids = new Ids([32,36,1])` id-tracker attachment (node_modules/bpmn-js/lib/BaseModeler.js) that BpmnFactory._ensureId() needs — this drives the ACTUAL palette entries end to end, including a real moddle.toXML() export; (2) the panel test uses react-dom/server's renderToStaticMarkup (also DOM-free, works in node env) to render PanelGroup/OutcomesPanel to real HTML and assert the `.open` class appears/disappears correctly. Neither test uses jsdom or testing-library (not installed in this repo) — both are real, non-mocked exercises of the actual fixed code paths.

Every step above must be done through the UI/browser — no curl/SQL/admin-REST shortcuts (LIVE_PROOF discipline, D-064).
deviations_from_adr: Scope was widened by ONE file beyond the two named in the task brief: gateway-condition-panel.jsx got the same `.open`-class fix as bpmn-properties-panel.jsx, because it independently reproduces the IDENTICAL P0-3 root cause (a `.bio-properties-panel-group-entries` div with no `.open` class, permanently display:none per editor.css) in the SAME properties-panel family reachable from the SAME modeler. Leaving it broken while claiming P0-3 fixed would have been dishonest — a user opening a gateway's condition panel would hit the exact same invisible-section bug the task was written to close. No other files were touched beyond this.

PanelGroup (previously a private, non-exported function in bpmn-properties-panel.jsx) is now exported, purely to make it directly unit-testable via react-dom/server — no behavior change, additive export only.
friction_events: Raw `node ./file.mjs` could not resolve bpmn-js's extensionless relative ESM imports (e.g. `from '../../util/ModelUtil'` without a file extension) outside of Vite/vitest's transform pipeline — the palette test had to be written and run through vitest directly rather than probed with a standalone node script first.

bpmn-js's BpmnFactory._ensureId() requires `moddle.ids` (an `Ids` instance from the `ids` package) to be attached, which is normally done by BaseModeler's constructor (needs a DOM). Replicated the one-line attachment (`moddle.ids = new Ids([32, 36, 1])`) directly in the test setup, matching BaseModeler.js's own code exactly.

The root `npm run fitness` script is a very long serial chain (180+ checks including the full `tsc` backend build) — took several minutes to complete; ran it as a background process and polled for completion rather than a single blocking foreground call.
